DUSACCOM · WEBSITE POLICIES

Privacy Policy

Website privacy notice · October 23, 2026

Your inquiry

The name, email address, company, topic, and message you enter are used to prepare an email inquiry on your device. In the current email-draft flow, the website does not submit or store those details on a server. You choose whether to send the prepared message using your email application. Your email provider’s policies apply to that service.

When you contact the Chamber

If you send an email or call us, DUSACCOM receives the information you choose to share and can use it to respond to your inquiry. Please do not include payment information or other sensitive details in an inquiry.

Preferences and analytics

This site saves your cookie choice in your browser’s local storage. Optional analytics are disabled unless you select “Accept all.” No analytics provider is configured in this version. If Google Analytics is configured later, it will load only after you consent. You can change your choice using “Cookie preferences” in the footer. Our analytics hooks do not receive form field values.

Hosting and external services

The hosting provider processes technical information needed to deliver this website, such as IP addresses and request metadata, under its own policies. Email links open your email application. Phone links open your calling application. Photos are served locally.

Questions and requests

For questions about this website or information you have shared with DUSACCOM, contact dusaccom1@gmail.com or 646-326-6052.
